name: audience-ad-testing-lab
description: Privacy-reviewed audience data, evidence-grounded panel construction, model-conditional ad screening, real-world study preparation, and uploaded aggregate result import with deterministic scoring, calibration, and marketer-ready dashboards.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare data and studies, build panels, and screen ads.
interface.longDescription: Prepare privacy-reviewed first-party evidence, research and build reusable evidence-grounded audience panels, evaluate ads with model-conditional synthetic screening, prepare a real-world outcome study, and import uploaded aggregate platform results for an explicit validation handoff.
defaultPrompt: Research and build a reusable audience panel.
Prepare approved audience or ad-platform data for testing.
Screen these ads and prepare the real-world validation handoff.
